name: io.github.hanoak/unsplash-mcp-server
title: Unsplash MCP Server
description: MCP server for the Unsplash API: search & fetch photos with attribution + download tracking.

environmentVariables.name: UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Unsplash API access key (sent as Authorization: Client-ID).

environmentVariables.name: UNSPLASH_APP_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Registered Unsplash app name, used as the attribution utm_source.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity; all logs go to stderr.
